Q5779.reason: Peripheral IV saline or heparin flushes are commonly ordered every 8 to 12 hours per facility policy, and 8 hours is the most frequently cited interval; the team note's every-4-hours figure is not a standard interval.

Q5227.reason: Under UCC 2-328(3), once the auctioneer calls for bids on goods sold without reserve and a bid ($100) is made, the goods cannot be withdrawn, so the woman can enforce the sale.

Q6156.reason: The company's attorney took the deposition, giving the company opportunity and a similar motive to examine the engineer, so the unavailable engineer's testimony fits former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1); the team note's hearsay conclusion overlooks this exception.
